name: Vectorization
purpose: Vectorization solves the problem of enabling AI agents to understand and process unstructured data based on its semantic meaning, rather than just keywords. It is crucial for providing AI agents with long-term memory, overcoming the context window limitations of large language models, and facilitating context-aware decision-making and retrieval-augmented generation.
coreComponents: Embedding Models (e.g., Word2Vec, GloVe, BERT, OpenAI's text-embedding-3)
Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Chroma, Elasticsearch)
Similarity Search Algorithms (e.g., Cosine Similarity, k-NN, HNSW, IVF)
keyCapabilities: Long-Term Memory and Contextual Awareness for AI Agents
Multi-Modal Data Processing (text, images, audio, video)
integrations: Large Language Models (LLMs) (e.g., OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini, Claude)
AI Agent Frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph)
Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Chroma, Elasticsearch, Supabase pgvector)
Enterprise Applications (CRMs, ERPs, project management tools)
useCases: Customer Support Automation and AI Knowledge Assistants
Semantic Search Engines and Recommendation Systems
Automated Procurement and Supply Chain Management
